result.title: EPI-SST: Renewal-Structured State-Space Transformers for Epidemic Forecasting
result.summary: Epidemic forecasting supports public health decisions ranging from capacity planning to intervention timing, for which both point accuracy and calibrated uncertainty are essential. Although neural models have advanced point forecasting, producing reliable probabilistic predictions over multiple future horizons remains challenging. Renewal models encode epidemic propagation, while neural forecasters learn flexible multi-horizon representations; integrating these strengths within a probabilistic future rollout remains underexplored. We propose EPI-SST (Epidemic State Space Transformer), a probabilistic forecaster centered on an evidence-driven renewal transition. At each horizon, neural evidence produces a bounded update to an internal multiplier and advances a finite-memory renewal state that generates the future mean trajectory. A separate heteroscedastic Gaussian head controls predictive scale using a validation-selected log-variance penalty. Across four epidemic surveillance benchmarks, EPI-SST achieves the lowest pooled RMSE on every dataset, reducing RMSE by up to 14.2 percent relative to the strongest baseline. It also achieves the lowest continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) at horizons h = 4, 5, 6 on every dataset, with reductions of up to 43 percent relative to the strongest probabilistic baseline. During the abnormal 2019-2020 influenza season, EPI-SST reduces CRPS by 16.9 percent and calibration error by 78.9 percent; a three-seed replication preserves its distributional lead. Ablation studies and frozen-path interventions show that the renewal transition, attention conditioning, horizon coupling, and uncertainty-scale control make complementary contributions to predictive performance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EPI-SST，用神经证据对内部乘子做有界更新，推进有限记忆的 renewal 状态以生成多步疫情轨迹，并以异方差高斯头配合验证集选择的 log-variance 惩罚校准不确定性，在四个监测基准上降低 RMSE 与 CRPS。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据驱动、有界更新的有限记忆状态逐步滚动」及针对预测分布的校准评价，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态迭代更新、证据筛选与不确定性评估提供参照，但该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，属较远领域，需核查状态更新的具体机制。
